section_summary.extract_value: This section details the testing and refinement of a hypothesized structural model, initially presented in Fig. 1. It describes the sample size (N=249) and the statistical methods used, including Mplus and various fit indices (CFI, SRMR, RMSEA). The process involved examining an initial model, trimming non-significant paths, and adding a path based on modification indices to arrive at a final, more parsimonious model (Fig. 2). The section discusses the variance accounted for in several model variables within this single study.
section_summary.evidence_source: Summary of the entire provided text content.

Sample.evidence_source: The number of participants (N = 249) exceeded the minimum 5:1 participants-to-parameter ratio needed to confidently examine a model (Bentler, 1990). In this study, a total of 225 participants were needed as there were 45 parameters (25 variable-to-variable paths, 10 standard error paths to the model variables, five BMI-to-variable paths, and five BMI standard error paths) in Fig. 1. Our sample size also exceeded the N \u2265 200 recommendation for complex models (Weston & Gore, 2006).
